proposals.evidence: DEDR 3729 gives Tamil/Malayalam/Kannada nūṟu, Kota/Gondi nūr, Kodagu nūri and Tulu nūdu ‘hundred’. These single-word hundred responses select the documented family; explicit one-plus-hundred compounds are excluded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
